- Timers now display estimated stop times, making them easier to use.
- Fixes an issue where Bluetooth connections might fail when clocking in or out in certain third-party apps.

## Smart, seamless connection
- Adds the "Automatically open received files" switch, which lets you choose whether to automatically open shared files upon receipt.

## Security & privacy
- Fixes an issue where, after unlocking with a fingerprint, swiping down from the left side of the task bar to open the notification drawer might result in a black screen.
